---
title: "Analysis"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
income_tx <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = "B19013_001",
  year = 2020,
  state = "TX",
  geometry = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
ggplot(income_tx) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = estimate), color = NA) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "viridis",
    name = "Median household income",
    labels = scales::label_dollar()
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "2020 Median Household Income by Texas County",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 ACS 5-year estimates"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| cache: true
edu_state <- get_acs(
  geography = "state",
  variables = c(
    total = "B15003_001",
    bachelors = "B15003_022",
    masters = "B15003_023",
    professional = "B15003_024",
    doctoral = "B15003_025"
  ),
  summary_var = "B15003_001",
  year = 2020
)
```

```{r}
edu_state |>
  group_by(GEOID, NAME) |>
  summarise(
    pct_bachelors_or_higher = 100 *
      sum(estimate[variable != "total"], na.rm = TRUE) /
      first(summary_est),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = reorder(NAME, pct_bachelors_or_higher),
    y = pct_bachelors_or_higher
  )) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(scale = 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Adults with a Bachelor's Degree or Higher by State",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Percentage of adults",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 ACS 5-year estimates"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0)
  )
```

```{r}
#| message: false
age_ca <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = c(
    median_age = "B01002_001",
    population = "B01003_001"
  ),
  year = 2020,
  state = "CA",
  geometry = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
age_ca_plot <- age_ca |>
  select(GEOID, NAME, variable, estimate) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = variable, values_from = estimate)

ggplot(age_ca_plot, aes(x = population, y = median_age)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text(
    data = slice_max(age_ca_plot, population, n = 5),
    aes(label = NAME),
    nudge_y = 0.5,
    check_overlap = TRUE
  ) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = scales::label_number()) +
  labs(
    title = "County Population and Median Age in California",
    x = "Population (log scale)",
    y = "Median age",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 ACS 5-year estimates"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0)
  )
```
